summary: Rogues are stealthy melee fighters who use energy and combo points to open from stealth, stun and incapacitate enemies and finish them with poisoned blades. They wear leather armour and fight with daggers and other one-handed weapons.
talent_levels_note: A talent ability can be taken once you can reach its row: the first talent point comes at level 10 and each row needs 5 more points, so row N opens at level 10 + 5 × (N − 1). Talent rows are from wowforevertalent.com; the Forever tooltips of Mutilate (40), Death Mark (40), Riposte (20), Blade Flurry, Premeditation (20) and Hemorrhage (30) show the same levels where they state one.

abilities.text: Ambush the target, causing 250% weapon damage plus 70 to the target. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.
abilities.summary: Ambush the target, causing 250% weapon damage plus 70 to the target.

abilities.name: Cheap Shot
abilities.text: Stuns the target for 4 sec. Must be stealthed. Awards 2 combo points.
abilities.summary: Stuns the target for 4 sec.

abilities.text: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.
abilities.summary: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

abilities.summary: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus an additional 40 with each weapon.

abilities.summary: Finishing move that causes damage over time, increased by your Attack Power.

abilities.text: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.
abilities.summary: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Backstab
abilities.text: Backstab the target, causing 150% weapon damage plus 10 to the target. Must be behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.
abilities.summary: Backstab the target, causing 150% weapon damage plus 10 to the target.

abilities.name: Blade Flurry
abilities.text: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.
abilities.summary: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

abilities.text: The rogue's dodge chance will increase by 50% for 15 sec.
abilities.summary: The rogue's dodge chance will increase by 50% for 15 sec.

abilities.text: Performs a feint, causing no damage but lowering your threat by a small amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.
abilities.summary: Performs a feint, causing no damage but lowering your threat by a small amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

abilities.text: Causes 10 damage, stops your attack, and incapacitates the target for 4 sec. The target must be facing you. Any damage taken will break the effect. Awards 1 combo point.
abilities.summary: Causes 10 damage, stops your attack, and incapacitates the target for 4 sec.

abilities.summary: Instantly strike with your off-hand weapon, dealing 50% weapon damage and generating 15 Energy.

abilities.summary: An instant strike that causes 3 damage in addition to your normal weapon damage.

abilities.summary: Increases the rogue's movement speed by 50% for 15 sec.

abilities.summary: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for up to 10 sec.

abilities.name: Death Mark
abilities.text:

abilities.summary: Sneak up on the trap in order to disarm it.

abilities.text: Throws a distraction, attracting the attention of all nearby enemies and reducing their Stealth detection as if they were 1 level lower for 10 seconds. Does not break stealth.
abilities.summary: Throws a distraction, attracting the attention of all nearby enemies and reducing their Stealth detection as if they were 1 level lower for 10 seconds.

abilities.text: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage, increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec, and causes your next Ambush or Garrote cast within 7 sec to not require Stealth. Awards 1 combo point.

changes: New spells: Mutilate (Assassination talent, row 7), Shank (Combat, level 24), Death Mark (Subtlety talent, row 7) and Poised (Subtlety, level 18, a passive).

Cold Blood, Premeditation, Ghostly Strike, Hemorrhage and Blade Flurry are changed and several talents are moved (Cold Blood to row 4, Premeditation to row 3, Ghostly Strike to row 4, Hemorrhage to row 5).
Adrenaline Rush now requires Blade Flurry.
New passive talents: Blood Splatter and Venom (Assassination), Puncturing Wounds, Composure, Flawless Execution and Flash of Steel (Combat), Dirty Tricks, Quick Getaway and Boot Knife (Subtlety).
Expose Armor, Rupture, Gouge, Feint, Sap, Distract and the Instant, Deadly, Mind-numbing and Wound Poisons are marked as changed on wowforevertalent.com.
conflicts: Sources disagree on when Death Mark unlocks (one guide says level 40, another the 31-point talent); both match row 7 (level 40), which the table uses.
Wowhead Forever lists Pick Lock, Detect Traps and Blinding Powder as trained spells at levels the fan site does not give; the table uses the tooltip levels.

Passive talents are not listed, including the new ones: Blood Splatter, Venom, Puncturing Wounds, Composure, Flawless Execution, Flash of Steel, Dirty Tricks, Quick Getaway, Boot Knife.
